title: Plantain and Butter Casserole with a Twist
description: A unique Thai-inspired casserole featuring plantains and a hint of Venezuelan flair. This dish combines the sweetness of plantains with the richness of butter, all wrapped up in a crispy, savory crust.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the plantain slices and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they're lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together the adventurous spices, Venezuelan cumin, and salt.
Sprinkle the spice mixture evenly over the plantain slices.
Transfer the plantain mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the plantains are tender and the top is golden brown.
